❤️ Rotary Friendship Exchange – Visit to School for Students with Disabilities

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE Argentina 2026–27 | District 4895

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange with Argentina, the RFE delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown visited a school serving students with disabilities in Argentina.

The visit was a deeply meaningful and enriching experience. The Rotarians had an opportunity to interact with the students, understand their educational environment, and learn about the efforts being made to support their education, inclusion, development and independence.

The warmth and enthusiasm of the students made the visit truly special. It was a beautiful reminder that service has no borders and inclusion is a universal Rotary value.

The visit also provided an opportunity to exchange ideas and experiences in the field of inclusive education and community service, strengthening the bond between Rotarians of District 3141 and District 4895.

Inclusion • Compassion • Service • Friendship

A memorable RFE experience that touched hearts and reinforced the Rotary spirit of Service Above Self.
